name: Hosted Agents — dynamic gateway
summary: Same as hosted-agents-static but routes through the dynamic-discovery APIM connection.
description: Self-provisions the same inline Invocations-protocol agent as `hosted-agents-static` but passes the dynamic-discovery gateway connection name as the container env var. See hosted-agents-static for the full flow. Marker: `slow` — opt-in via `pytest -m slow`.
notes: **Concept verified** by the `hosted-agents-canary` card, which probes both the static AND dynamic-discovery gateways from inside the container (`BYOM_MODEL` + `BYOM_MODEL_DYNAMIC` env vars) and returns `ok:true` for the `responses-openai-dynamic` sub-probe. This card's test uses `remote_build` (Foundry builds the container from an inline zip), which is slower/cold-start-flaky, hence still `slow` + `xfail`. The BYOM behavior on the wire is identical to the canary.
